description: Desktop app for ToolHive, built with Electron, React, TypeScript, and Vite. Covers developing, testing, and packaging the app, its connection to the embedded thv binary, deep links, and branding.
rules: Don't hand-edit the generated API client in `common/api/generated`. Run `pnpm run generate-client` to regenerate it from the ToolHive OpenAPI spec.
To test a custom `thv` build in development, run `thv serve --openapi --socket=<path>`, then `THV_SOCKET=<path> pnpm run start`. Packaged builds ignore `THV_SOCKET`.
For ToolHive CLI, Kubernetes operator, and vMCP usage, see the ToolHive documentation at docs.stacklok.com/toolhive.
